name: Greater Healing Draught
description: A concentrated field remedy with a copper seal.
purpose: Action: heal 4d4+4 HP in or out of combat.

name: Climbing Kit
description: Pitons, harness and tested anchors, packed to be used rather than collected.
purpose: Reusable: grants advantage on climbing routes that name this tool. At level 6, Fieldcraft also adds +2 to those checks.

name: Storm Grounder
description: A braid of copper with ceramic handholds.
purpose: Reusable: opens protected approaches to charged ward machinery and grants advantage on the named storm checks.

name: Shuttered Lantern
description: A hooded lamp with a long-burning wick.
purpose: Reusable: helps investigation in mines and drowned ruins when shown on a route card. Routine fuel tracking is deliberately omitted.

name: Medicinal Herbs
purpose: Workshop ingredient: two bundles and 8 gold make one Greater Healing Draught. May also be sold.

name: Ward Crystal Fragment
description: A stable splinter recovered from a damaged ward.
purpose: Workshop ingredient: one fragment and 30 gold make a Sentinel Charm. No quest requires this material, so crafting or selling is safe.

name: Sentinel Charm
description: A small ward which firms the wearer’s resolve.
purpose: Equip: +1 to every saving throw; useful for poison and magical hazards.

name: Wayfarer’s Boots
description: Boots stitched for sure footing, not speed.
purpose: Equip in the accessory slot: +2 Athletics and Survival. Replaces any other accessory.

name: Dueling Blade
purpose: Finesse, 1d8 piercing, +1 to hit. A precision alternative to heavier weapons.

name: Roadwarden Greatsword
description: A two-handed blade that makes defending a doorway a commitment.
purpose: Strength, 2d6 slashing. Two-handed: equipping removes your shield, trading defense for damage.

name: Frontier Warbow
description: A reinforced bow for deliberate shots.
purpose: Dexterity, 1d8 piercing. Two-handed ranged weapon; +1 to hit.

name: Wardbinder Staff
description: Its bronze rings hum when a spell holds steady.
purpose: Equip: +2 spell attack bonus, +1 spell save DC. Occupies your main hand.

name: Field Plate
description: Articulated plate repaired by an outpost smith.
purpose: Base AC 17, no Dexterity bonus. Heavy and conspicuous: −2 Stealth. Any class may wear it in this custom ruleset.

name: Duelist’s Buckler
description: A light buckler for turning blows into openings.
purpose: +1 AC (less than a steel shield), but +1 weapon attack bonus. Cannot be used with a two-handed weapon.

name: Ward Oil
description: One application makes a blade resonate against bound spirits.
purpose: Apply outside combat to a party member. Their next three successful weapon hits deal +1d4 radiant damage; persists across battles until used.

name: Scholar’s Lens
description: A glass lens mounted in a ring of etched silver.
purpose: Equip: +2 Arcana and Investigation; −1 AC. Helps deciphering at the cost of protection.

name: Resonant Blade
description: An unusual blade traded for stories of broken wards.
purpose: Finesse, 1d8 radiant damage. Bypasses physical resistance, but no extra attack bonus.
